# David Packer Recommends Six To Eight Front Lever Pulls As A Minimum Prerequisite Before Front Lever Pull-Ups

David Packer recommends that six to eight straight arm front lever pulls is the minimum prerequisite before you can start doing front lever pull-ups. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- Six to eight front lever pulls was the minimum level needed before being able to do front lever pull-ups without specifically training them. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- As soon as he hit that level he could start doing front lever pull-ups without even training them. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "so i always said to you six to eight front lever pulls was the minimum ... as soon as i hit that um so that that level i could start doing front lever pull-ups without even um you know training it"
